T2_attachment.verdict: END attachment reproduces x^14 + 48x^13 of T2 (arXiv 2305.01784); the INNER attachment gives x^14 + 81x^13 + ... and does NOT match

stars.description: Stars K_{1,m}; closed form (1+x)^m+x, DP cross-checked
notes: I(K_{1,m}) = (1+x)^m + x used as closed form for every m; DP cross-check for 530 values of m (all m <= 500 and multiples of 50).
Q_2 = 2m^2+m+1 verified exactly for all 3 <= m <= 2000: True.

spiders.description: Spiders S(k legs x length l)

brooms.description: Brooms: path on h vertices + star of m leaves at one end

double_brooms.description: Double brooms: path on h vertices, m1 and m2 leaves at the ends

caterpillars.description: Caterpillars: seeded random leg counts, one-hub and regular

klym_3star_k_k+1.description: Kadrawi-Levit (3*,k,k+1) trees (P4 attached at an END vertex)

galvin_Tmt1.description: Galvin T_{m,t,1}: t=2..12, m=1..40, plus T_{t,t,1} to t=20

bencs_T2m1n.description: Bencs spherically symmetric T(2^m 1^n) with multiple LC breaks

unions.description: Disjoint unions: mT1, mT2, T1+T2, T1+stars/E_m/paths/matchings, star forests

random_trees.description: Uniform random labelled trees (Prüfer), n=30,50,100,200,300, 600 each

random_forests.description: Random recursive forests (parent pointers kept w.p. q), n=30..200

spider_stars.description: Centre with a pendant K2's and b pendant leaves, a,b<=60

star_plus_isolated.description: K_{1,m} + E_j (forest extremal configuration at r=2)

star_of_stars.description: Root with k children each with m leaves

fixed_n_shapes.description: All hub-like shapes at fixed n=30,60,100 (ratio compared at equal order)

patternboost60.description: Ramos-Sun PatternBoost final-epoch 60-vertex trees (50k Prüfer codes)
